Hi all — thanks for the details and the screenshot, Alice. We pulled the Coupa SSO logs and see the NameID in the assertion normalized to the canonical mailbox (alice@greenbridge.co) while the invite was issued to alice+procure@greenbridge.co. Many IdPs collapse plus-addressing on the assertion while the portal link validation is literal, which causes an audience mismatch.

Workarounds (pick one):
1) I can reissue the invite to alice@greenbridge.co (canonical) — fastest.
2) If you prefer the alias, your IdP admin can add alice+procure@greenbridge.co as an alternate email (NameID) mapping in the SAML configuration so the assertion includes the exact alias.
3) Try the invite in a private/incognito window after clearing cookies — occasionally session sticky cookies cause the portal to compare the wrong email.

I'm going to reissue an invite to alice@greenbridge.co now and attach a short diagnostic log from our end (saml-diagnostics.log). If that doesn't work, we'll open a vendor SAML exception with Coupa and add a temporary manual mapping to onboard you.

Action taken: reissued invite to alice@greenbridge.co (link expires in 48 hours).
